subject: Praxis Health - tenant gateway & admin seed plan
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@praxishealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@praxishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New tenant setup — initial access & API keys

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. We want to get a minimal production tenant ready for our engineering team by next Thursday (1/19). Priorities for our first pass:
- One production namespace for the web app (api.praxis.prod) and one sandbox namespace for dev/testing.
- Short-lived admin invites for 3 engineers, plus one long-term admin service account for CI/CD.
- API keys: we need a temporary developer key (1 week TTL) to validate requests, and a rotation plan for the long-term key.
- Role templates: Editor, Reader, Service-Administrator (for CI). Can you confirm Redwood has a mapping for these or will we need custom roles?

We attached our internal requirements doc. Also looping in procurement for contract/PO questions.

Appreciate a quick plan and who from your side will own the seeding of projects and keys.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Director, Platform Engineering
Praxis Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@praxishealth.com>
Cc: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@praxishealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New tenant setup — initial access & API keys

Jordan — thanks, this is clear and a realistic target. High level plan below; I'll own the coordination + we'll hand off the API seeding to Ben.

Summary plan (first 72 hours):
1) Tenant and namespace creation: create a single tenant "praxis-health" with two projects: praxis-prod and praxis-sandbox.
2) Role templates: Redwood has built-in Reader/Editor and a customizable Service-Administrator template. I've attached a CSV with suggested role bindings.
3) Invites: generate ephemeral admin invites (7-day expiry) for the 3 engineers; create a service account for CI with restricted scope.
4) API keys: Ben will seed a temporary developer key (7-day TTL) for validation and provision a long-term service key with rotation policy (90 days) and an HSM-wrapped secret for production.
5) Security/compliance: share SOC2 scoping notes and audit log retention (we're set to 365 days by default).

Action items for Praxis (please reply in-thread):
- Confirm the canonical emails for the 3 engineers to invite.
- Approve the proposed role templates (attached).
- Confirm whether CI will run from a static IP (for IP allowlisting).

Attachments: praxis-tenant-init-checklist.pdf; praxis-service-role-templates.csv

Next internal step: I'm going to forward the seeding request to our onboarding engineer (Ben) to create the initial projects and seed an ephemeral key. Monica, can you schedule a 30-min handoff on Wed 1/11?

Thanks,
—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Manager, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@praxishealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: New tenant setup — initial access & API keys

Ben — looping you in for seeding. Please create tenant praxis-health, projects praxis-prod and praxis-sandbox, and do the following:
- Create role templates per attached CSV and grant temporary invites to the 3 engineers (Jordan to confirm emails).
- Seed a developer key with TTL 7 days, label: praxis-dev-temp.
- Create service account "praxis-ci-sa" scoped to model inference and admin:deploy (narrowed to only the project).
- Generate a long-term key for praxis-ci-sa with `rotation_window=90d` and store the secret with KMS label "praxis-prod-kms". Notify security for HSM wrap.

Please post the key stubs (key id and created_at) in the thread when done. If you need dedicated capacity to meet throughput during initial ramp, flag here and Monica will follow up with sales ops.

—Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@praxishealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: New tenant setup — initial access & API keys

All right — done with the initial seeding steps. Summary below and stubbed artifacts attached.

Seeding summary:
- Tenant: praxis-health (id: tnt_0a9f)
- Projects: praxis-prod (proj_id: p_4c3), praxis-sandbox (proj_id: p_4c4)
- Role templates created: Reader, Editor, Service-Administrator (matched to attached CSV)
- Invites queued: ephemeral invites created for invites@placeholder (waiting for Jordan to provide the 3 canonical emails; invites will expire in 7 days once accepted)
- Developer key (temp): key_id kd_temp_732 — TTL 7d — Usage: test traffic for staging URL
- Service account: praxis-ci-sa (sa_21) — long-term key key_id ks_prod_198 — rotation_window=90d; secret stored with KMS label praxis-prod-kms (HSM wrap pending security confirmation)

Attachments (stubs):
- praxis-key-kd_temp_732.txt (type: text)
- praxis-key-ks_prod_198.txt (type: text)

Notes / next steps:
- Jordan: reply with the three engineer emails and confirm whether CI needs a static egress IP to add to allowlist.
- Monica: please start the capacity check if Praxis expects more than 5 rps sustained for inference during rollout.

If everything looks good I can trigger the DocuSign envelope with the long-term key access addendum (Ben to Jordan) — we usually require the signed key custody agreement before enabling HSM wrap.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Onboarding Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@praxishealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@praxishealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New tenant setup — initial access & API keys

Thanks team — this is great progress. Confirming the three engineers for ephemeral invites:
- rachel.hansen@praxishealth.com
- marc.lopez@praxishealth.com
- dev-team+rohit@praxishealth.com

CI will run from our build-hosts behind a NAT; we can provide the static egress IP range by EOD tomorrow.

Jordan — we approve the role templates in the attached CSV. Please proceed with the HSM wrap once the DocuSign addendum is signed. We'll have procurement finish the PO by next Tuesday.

Best,
Jordan
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@praxishealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New tenant setup — initial access & API keys

Jordan — thanks for the confirmations. I scheduled a 30-minute handoff with Ben and Soojin for Fri 1/13 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through invite acceptance, key retrieval (ephemeral flow), and allowlist steps. Calendar invite sent.

I'll also open a capacity ticket with Sales Ops in case Praxis decides to spin dedicated capacity during early ramp. Expect a follow-up with an estimated timeline.

—Monica
